How to use & source artwork

The limits are twenty words per caption, three lines, and twenty-five characters per line including spaces and punctuation. Auto compact favours a compact bubble with evenly filled rows and complete sentences where they fit. It compares actual text widths and penalizes excess empty space at line ends. Choose 1, 2 or 3 lines to filter the suggestions, then click a layout card to preview that exact arrangement. Two lines may differ slightly in width; the lower row can be up to five characters longer when it completes the sentence. Complete sentences and balanced use of space take priority over making the top row longer. With three lines, the middle may be widest. A shortest middle row is allowed only when it is no more than three characters shorter than the first row. The text editor, selected miniature and main preview always share the same line breaks. Every line has a hard maximum of 25 characters, including spaces and punctuation. This applies to automatic layouts only. Manual mode permits your own line lengths, line counts and single-word rows. Only feasible line counts are offered; we never widen beyond the limit to fill the options. The right-hand rag is the primary visual criterion. In Manual line breaks mode, press Enter where you want a break. A one-word second row is allowed only after a completed question or sentence whose first row cannot fit the extra word within the active line-length limit. Automatic layout also permits a single-word second row when it is at least 50% shorter than the first, counting punctuation. A one-line option is available only when the complete caption fits within 25 characters. The 20-word limit also applies. If a rule needs attention, your exact entered lines stay visible in a draft bubble with guidance below. In manual mode these layout rules never block downloads; only empty text or unsupported font characters need correction.

The visible gap between rows is at most 0.20× the text size, and reduces if tall accents need extra clearance. For one line, left/right padding is 0.75×. Outer margins scale by 1.00× / 1.41× / 1.73× for one / two / three lines to maintain visual breathing room. The visible gap between rows must never exceed the surrounding text margins. Top spacing is measured from Inter’s capital cap line and bottom spacing from its fixed lowercase descender line. Both use the same margin: 0.50× text size multiplied by the line-count factor. Ascenders, capitals, commas and descenders use that reserved space without moving either margin. The small bubble remains the same proportion at every corner. Open SVG in Illustrator and save as .ai if you need a native Illustrator file.

Bubble geometry and gradient values were extracted from DS-ProfileAssets.ai. Inter Regular replaces the source font at the owner’s request. The artwork is for owner review. This file runs locally without uploading captions. The built-in character set covers Latin letters, accented Latin letters and common punctuation; unsupported characters are flagged.
